newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Lebed says U.S. like "bull in China shop".
newsitem.headline: Russia's Lebed says U.S. like "bull in China shop".

text.p: The United States is behaving like a "bull in a china shop" by launching air strikes against Iraq, Russian security chief Alexander Lebed said on Thursday.
"There is one big strong master (in the world) who spits on everybody," Interfax news agency quoted Lebed as saying.
"That master is behaving like a bull in a china shop," Lebed told journalists on his way to the rebel Russian region of Chechnya on his latest peace mission.
The former paratroop general went on to say that U.S. President Bill Clinton had carried out the attacks to boost his democratic image.
"This is the essence of true democracy -- carry out air raids and then gather the journalists to applaud," Lebed said.

Russia has denounced the air strikes, launched by the U.S. against Iraq in retaliation for Baghdad's military operation against separatist Kurds in the north, described the U.S. action as "inappropriate" and wants all military activity in the region to be stopped.
